scope: Current Express HTTP API source registration inventory. Static frontend paths, middleware-only registrations and /api/* unknown-operation catchall are excluded.
method: TypeScript AST walk over app.get/post/put/patch/delete calls in supabase/*.ts except staticFrontend.ts, plus imported googleAuth.ts. Literal path arrays are expanded. Three inspect/accept loops are expanded from their actual constant arrays. Installer reachability was reviewed against supabase/app.ts and auth/payments nested installers.
caveats: Counts describe source registrations, not a runtime HTTP probe, end-to-end validation, unique business workflows or migration completion.
Two method/path pairs have intentional chained registrations: POST /api/auth/google/start and GET /api/auth/google/callback. They are counted once in distinct_source_method_path_pairs.
Method/path strings containing :parameters remain parameterized patterns, not enumerated concrete URLs.
Unknown retirement status means no retirement conclusion was drawn, not that the endpoint was tested active.
Private operator workers and background tasks are outside the HTTP endpoint count and listed separately.
Supabase already provides sole runtime persistence; this inventory concerns an optional Express runtime replacement, not a pending JSON data migration.

background_and_operator_work.name: Notification invalidation SSE
background_and_operator_work.details: PostgreSQL LISTEN listener, 25-second heartbeat and live actor recheck; stream ends after 10 minutes. In-memory stream cap is 128 total, 20 per IP, 3 per Auth subject. Supabase Realtime replacement must preserve recipient isolation and revocation.

background_and_operator_work.name: Order reservation expiry
background_and_operator_work.details: Startup and 60-second tick, no overlapping local batch, at most 50 candidates per tick; transactional store/listing/order locks, audit, notifications and PIN cleanup.

background_and_operator_work.name: Payment reversal reconciliation
background_and_operator_work.details: Startup and 15-second tick, one local pending task; durable leases, provider verification, retries and idempotent access reconciliation must survive process replacement.

background_and_operator_work.name: Support email outbox
background_and_operator_work.details: 30-second tick and reply-triggered flush; deliverSupportEmail leases up to 5 emails, allows 8 attempts, uses 15-second provider timeout and stable Resend idempotency key. SMTP authentication mail is a separate hosted Auth configuration.

background_and_operator_work.name: Reviewed residence execution worker
background_and_operator_work.details: Separate private operator binary, preview default. --execute and optional --watch; 15-second poll. Up to 10 execution requests and 20 storage cleanup jobs per batch. Restores/reverifies saved recovery evidence and exact current founder consent; not a normal HTTP handler.

background_and_operator_work.name: Reviewed system wipe worker
background_and_operator_work.details: Separate gated private operator binary, preview default. --execute and optional --watch; 15-second poll, up to 10 reviewed requests per batch. Depends on private filesystem recovery material and subprocess restore tooling.
